svg.title: Claude Haiku 5.5: from 800 rows, single-pass costs more than agentic with table parsing
svg.desc: 100-row statements, 5 documents × 3 runs: Single-pass (baseline setup) 100% at $6.73 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing on 100% at $1.80 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing off 100% at $11.5 extraction cost per 1,000 documents; 400-row statements, 5 documents × 3 runs: Single-pass (baseline setup) 64% at $16.0 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing on 100% at $4.38 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing off 98% at $36.1 extraction cost per 1,000 documents; 800-row statements, 5 documents × 3 runs: Single-pass (baseline setup) 62% at $137 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing on 100% at $8.52 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing off 100% at $68.4 extraction cost per 1,000 documents; 1,600-row statements, 5 documents × 3 runs: Single-pass (baseline setup) 2% at $117 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing on 100% at $15.6 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing off 100% at $131 extraction cost per 1,000 documents; 3,200-row statements, 5 documents × 3 runs: Agentic, table parsing on 100% at $25.0 extraction cost per 1,000 documents, Agentic, table parsing off 100% at $284 extraction cost per 1,000 documents; Fixed: Amazon Textract with Tables and Layout, in place of the baseline setup's Amazon Textract with Layout only. Everything else is the baseline setup (the ablation registry's develop baseline): holistic classification reading text and page images, single-pass extraction, and confidence scoring, all on Claude Haiku 5.5, with no escalation to a second scoring model.
